concept.title: Checking the tire inflation pressure
concept.shortdesc: After driving briefly so as to distribute the sealant in the tire, check the inflation pressure.

keywords.indexterm: tire mobility kit checking the tire inflation pressure

li.p: After driving approximately 7–10 km (4–6 miles or about 10 minutes), stop at a safe location.
Connect the compressor and the tire connection hose directly to the tire valve.
To check the current tire pressure, temporarily turn off the compressor:
To increase the inflation pressure, switch on the compressor, position I. To check the current inflation pressure setting, briefly switch off the compressor.
To reduce the inflation pressure, press the valve on the compressor.

note.p: Do not let the compressor run for more than 10 minutes. Otherwise, the device may overheat and be damaged.

When you use the TMK with a sealant that is not approved by Kia, the tire pressure sensors may be damaged by that sealant. Approved sealant on the tire pressure sensor and wheel should be removed when you replace the tire and the tire pressure sensors should be inspected at an authorized Kia dealer/service partner .
The pressure gauge may show higher than actual reading when the compressor is running. To get an accurate tire reading, the compressor needs to be turned off.
